title: The history of The Alhambra from a local tour guide who knows here stuff
text: We had the best and most knowledgeable tour guide for our 3.5 hour tour of The Alhambra.  What an amazing day filled with so much knowledge and history about the origins of the Alhambra.  Nuria made the tour enjoyable and provided wonderful examples and images of the history.  I highly recommend this tour and Nuria as your tour guide. She knows here stuff. We did the tour in English, but she speaks multiple languages.
author: Ralicast

title: Best English Tour Guide Ever ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️
text: Georgia our guide was the best English tour guide I have ever seen. Perfect English and at the same time perfect spanish. She was thorough, answered all questions, attention to detail and time management was all 5 ⭐️. It was a great tour in itself, Granada trip is incomplete without this tour.
author: asimalis

title: Excellent tour of Alhambra by Antonio.
text: Our guide Antonio gave a fantastic 3 hour tour of the Alhambra. There is so much to see and Antonio was able to provide the right level of information in a very charming way. Thank Antonio for being our guide.
author: 431kend

title: Alhambra / Generalife Tour
text: Our tour guide, Fernando was great. Very knowledgeable of the history and patient with the tour group. Knew where to take amazing pictures while keeping us entertained with the history of the Alhambra. Would recommend him to tour friends and family that would visit.
author: H3y_ward

title: Exceptional tour of an incredible place
text: Arnau gave us a brilliant tour of the Alhambra, so much history and detail about such a vast and complex space! I'm VERY glad I decided to do a guided tour instead of just wandering around myself, I would have appreciated the site just a fraction as much. Thanks Arnau for your boundless energy, enthusiasm and incredible knowledge!
author: N3272GHrosiet

title: Very enjoyable
text: Carlos was very entertaining, interesting and informative. He made us feel like old friendo who could enjoy a laugh during the tour, nothing was too much trouble.
author: Morna_H

title: Small group guided tour
text: Carlos was very informative and helpful. He prioritised making us feel very welcome and that our interests were important to him. The Nasrid Palaces were exceedingly beautiful and interesting in particular
author: mornah489

title: Spectacular Alhambra
text: We took the “Skip the Line” small group tour of the Alhambra today. Our guide was Victoria, great! She was energetic, knowledgeable, answered group questions, made sure we stayed together and had a great sense of humor. I highly recommend this tour and Victoria as your guide.
author: lindasI7229IA
